text:
laura: Packaging for private VPC release v1.4.9-rc2 ready to ship. Canaries scheduled in 2h. Need final checksum sign-off. @matt @shawn

matt: Running preflight now, starting sha checks across mirrors.

deploy-bot: packaging-job 67890 started. logs: https://ci.redwood/67890 :gear:

shawn: quick heads up — local preflight sha256 for offline-bundle.tar.gz != manifest. expected: sha256:abc123def4567890 got: sha256:abf321de6549870

shawn: (run)
```
$ sha256sum offline-bundle.tar.gz
abf321de6549870  offline-bundle.tar.gz
```

laura: did signer rotate or did packaging change compression flags recently?

ops-bot: cosign check: signer=signer-20240228, expiry=2024-02-28T00:00:00Z, status=valid

matt: I see the same mismatch on mirror-3. Looks like the tarball digest differs (maybe gzip level change). If we repack, downstream pins will break unless we bump manifest version.

laura: proposal: HOLD canary. Do not promote. Create new signed manifest (increment epoch) with corrected hash and republish. Tag decision: either rc2.1 or rc2a — prefer rc2.1 so history is linear.

releasemgr: prefer rc2.1. We'll update release notes and customer comms. Also add a note that airgap customers should re-pull images after the new manifest propagates (~2h mirror TTL).

shawn: I'll repack with gzip -n -6 (to make deterministic) and cosign, then publish. ETA ~45m. Will run full sha sweep: mirror-1..4

deploy-bot: packaging-job 67890 finished: status=failed (sha mismatch). starting packaging-job 67891 (repack + cosign).

deploy-bot: packaging-job 67891 logs: https://ci.redwood/67891

deploy-bot: packaging-job 67891 completed: status=success

deploy-bot: cosign: signature OK, manifest v13 published, manifest-hash: sha256:feedfacecafebeef000111222333444555666777888999aaaabbbbccccdddd1111

matt: verified new manifest hash on all mirrors. sha256sum offline-bundle.tar.gz ->  feedfacecafebeef000111222333444555666777888999aaaabbbbccccdddd1111

laura: OK — schedule canary now: single VPC cluster, 15m observation, checks: installer flow success rate >=98%, p95 install latency <=500ms, no checksum mismatch at pull time.

laura: rollback trigger (pre-agreed): if any mirror returns checksum mismatch, or error rate >2% or p95 >500ms for install flow, run rollback to previous pinned manifest and pause releases.

matt: rollback command (manual):
```
# pin back to last stable manifest
deployctl pin --component=installer --manifest=v1.4.8 --reason="canary rollback: rc2.1 mismatch"
```

releasemgr: I'll update release notes: add entry "v1.4.9-rc2.1: republished signed manifest to fix checksum mismatch across mirrors; airgap customers should re-pull images after 2h TTL." Also note the canary window and rollback criteria.

shawn: pushing final prod tag after canary passes. If canary fails, we'll keep rc2.1 unpublished and triage packaging script.

laura: thanks all. @deploy-bot please annotate the release with manifest v13 hash and runtime notes. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: annotated release v1.4.9-rc2.1 with manifest-hash feedfacecafebeef000111222333444555666777888999aaaabbbbccccdddd1111

laura: ack. starting canary in 5m.

matt: watching logs. ping if anything spikes.

releasemgr: prepping support blurb.

shawn: will follow up with PR for packaging script fix (gzip flags + deterministic metadata).
